description.text: The BA program in finance is designed to provide students with the financial knowledge and skills required for successful business careers. It attempts to give students a thorough understanding of theoretical financial principles and the practical implementation of these principles in the world of business. Students learn how financial markets operate and how to make effective investment and financial decisions for firms and individuals. Finance knowledge and practice have become crucial for the success of corporations and their employees. This program not only teaches finance and accounting techniques with the aim of immediate application but also enables students to critically evaluate their usefulness in global contexts. The program includes General Education, Finance Concentration and Electives. The General Education is to develop students’ knowledge and skills in areas of Academic Writing, Foreign Language, Epistemology and Cognition, Ethical Thought and Moral Values, Historical Analysis, Literature and the Arts, Quantitative Reasoning, Science and Technology, Social Analysis, etc. The Finance Concentration mainly includes: Introduction to Finance Quantitative Methods for Accounting and Finance Financial Accounting Accounting Information Systems Financial Regulations and Corporate Governance Managing Personal Finance Economics for International Finance Investment Management In Elective Courses students are allowed to choose additional courses in finance or related areas. Courses offered include Chinese Financial System Reform and a variety of economics courses. Students are also given opportunities to select courses from other department that not related to finance. The BA program is a full-time 3 to 4-year program. Students in this program can apply to transfer to US or UK partner universities from their third year if entry requirementsare met. Not all general education courses are compulsory for students who may transfer to UK partner universities.

duration.text: The BA in Finance at China Agricultural University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Prospective students must have a high school diploma or its equivalent.
